subject: Breakglass scheduling: marketplace demo window for Nebula Systems
messages:
From: Neil Patel <neil@nebulasys.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: prodops@acme.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace joint demo — availability and constraints

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for agreeing to coordinate a joint marketplace demo with our SI partner and AWS Marketplace. Acme (prodops@acme.com) is the target customer. They need a short, focused 45–60 minute session covering: 1) Marketplace listing and procurement flow, 2) dedicated deployment options, and 3) a quick live demo of common inference patterns.

Constraints:
- Customer is APAC-heavy and prefers late-afternoon UTC (18:00–22:00 UTC).
- Our SI (internal scheduling) wants to avoid their Monday/Friday blocks.
- Acme has an internal release freeze on 2027-05-04.

Proposed rough windows (all UTC):
- 2027-05-03 18:00–19:15
- 2027-05-05 19:00–20:15

I attached a short customer-context.pdf. Can you share Redwood availability and any routing preferences (hosted vs dedicated demo)?

Cheers,
Neil
Neil Patel
Strategic Alliances, Nebula Systems
attachments: customer-context.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Neil Patel <neil@nebulasys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace joint demo — availability and constraints

Hi Neil — thanks for the context and for flagging the customer freeze on 5/4. Looping in Karthik from SI coordination.

We can run a live demo with a focused procurement walkthrough + hosted inference smoke test. Two operational notes and a suggestion for a "breakglass" contingency policy so the customer isn't blocked by last-minute SI or marketplace outages:
- Preferred demo length: 60 minutes (40 min demo + 20 min Q&A).
- Default routing: start on Redwood Hosted API (fastest onboarding) and failover to a Dedicated session if customer requests isolated capacity during the call.

Suggested primary and fallback windows (UTC):
- Primary: 2027-05-03 18:00–19:00 (fits APAC late afternoon)
- Breakglass fallback: 2027-05-05 18:30–19:30 (we reserve this as a warm standby slot)

If the SI or AWS partner needs to move, we can activate the breakglass slot up to 24 hours before the call. I attached a short runbook (breakglass-runbook.md) and a proposed agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf).

Can you confirm whether 5/03 primary works for Acme or if they prefer the fallback 5/05? Also please confirm the SI contact who will present the procurement flow.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB), breakglass-runbook.md (Markdown, 6KB)

Thanks Vanessa — quick update from the AWS Marketplace side. We have an org all-hands and cannot support a joint presentation on 2027-05-03 after 17:30 PDT. Our earliest available window is 2027-05-05 19:00–20:00 UTC (which maps to 12:00–13:00 PDT) — looks like that aligns with Neil's second option.

Proposal: lock the breakglass slot (2027-05-05 18:30–19:30 UTC) as the demo time and treat 5/03 as a rehearsal for internal stakeholders only. If Acme confirms they can do 5/05 we will join live and present the procurement flow.

Perfect — thanks all for the quick replies. Confirming we will run the public demo on:

Date: 2027-05-05
Time: 19:00–20:00 UTC (12:00–13:00 PDT)
Location: Google Meet (calendar invite sent) — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-20270505

Agenda (confirmed):
- 12:00–12:05 PDT: Introductions
- 12:05–12:25 PDT: Marketplace / procurement flow (Leslie, AWS)
- 12:25–12:45 PDT: Redwood live demo — hosted onboarding + inference patterns (Vanessa)
- 12:45–13:00 PDT: SI notes, edge cases, next steps (Karthik + Neil)

Operational notes:
- Breakglass policy: if AWS or SI goes dark within 24 hours, Redwood will stand up a dedicated session and provide a private join link; Karthik will own the Dedicated activation checklist.
- Attachments: attaching the final redwood-demo-agenda.pdf and the breakglass-runbook.md. Please review runbook playback steps before EOD 2027-05-04.

Neil / Acme: can you confirm attendee list (names + emails) so we can include them on the calendar invite?

Thanks — I sent the calendar invite and included the document links.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
